title: Tangent projections of a translated varifold
statement: Let n, l be natural numbers, U and U' arbitrary subsets of R^(n+l), V a rectifiable n-varifold in U with carrier M and multiplicity theta, V' a rectifiable n-varifold in U', xi in R^(n+l) and tau(x) = x - xi. If V'.carrier = tau(M) and V'.mult(y) = theta(y + xi) for every y, then V'.tangentProj y = V.tangentProj (y + xi) for every y in R^(n+l), where tangentProj is the contract's orthogonal projection onto the (classically chosen) weighted approximate tangent space where one exists and 0 elsewhere.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (U U' : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (V' : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U') (ξ : Amb n ℓ), V'.carrier = (fun x => x - ξ) '' V.carrier → (∀ y, V'.mult y = V.mult (y + ξ)) → ∀ y, V'.tangentProj y = V.tangentProj (y + ξ)
